title: Complete Website Research Pipeline Roadmap
goal: Analyze approved websites deeply enough to answer operator questions and create source-linked memory without unbounded crawling.
no_gpu_strategy: Use headless Chromium with software rendering, DOM/accessibility extraction and screenshots; do not require GPU acceleration.

example_task.request: analysiere die asv bw hilfeseite vollstaendig und fasse alle informationen im gedaechtnis zusammen

slice_queue.goal: Convert operator intent into a bounded crawl scope with domain allowlist, path rules, depth and page caps.
Collect canonical URLs, titles, headings, link graph, content hashes and crawl gaps without storing raw page dumps.
Synthesize topics, processes, contacts, warnings, FAQs and unknowns from source chunks under DSGVO/model routing policy.
Make large website research resumable with checkpointed frontier, dedupe state, budgets and retry metadata.
Run a bounded ASV BW help-site pilot and produce a redacted source inventory plus memory candidates.

done_definition: A full-site task cannot run without explicit bounds.
Research packets include source refs and content hashes, not raw dumps.
The pipeline reports skipped pages and uncertainty.
The ASV BW pilot can produce memory-ready abstractions from a bounded crawl.
